title: symbol entities invisible to hybrid_search and inspect_entity despite live edges — exact-symbol eval queries cannot pass
wanted_capability: Symbol entities resolvable on the retrieval surfaces. Schema reports ~110k symbol vertices and the edge sidecar serves DEFINED_IN/CONTAINS_SYMBOL edges naming them, but (1) bbox_hybrid_search returns zero symbol-type results even BM25-only with doc_type=symbol for exact names (KnowledgeStore, EntityRef, resolve_project_context), and (2) bbox_inspect_entity returns error.not_found for the exact symbol ref the edge sidecar itself emits (SymbolProvider::get_entity requires idx.entity_properties, which misses). Consequence: the eval suite's exact-symbol queries can never surface their expected symbol refs through search (R@k ceiling visibly depressed on the refreshed suite), and graph hops landing on a symbol vertex cannot be inspected. Wanted: symbol entity docs present in the entity index (backfilled on reindex after the g8 schema bump, if that is the cause) or an inspect/search path that resolves symbols from the edge sidecar.
fallback_used: Derived current symbol refs mechanically via bbox_refactor_project_refs (defn_hash == defining chunk_hash) and verified existence through the chunk's DEFINED_IN in-edge instead of inspect/search.
evidence: live probe 2026-06-12: symbol:d723917f:KnowledgeStore:40e76235... not_found via inspect while DEFINED_IN edge names it
notes: PARTIAL (commit 08b49f4a, worktree-search-arc-residuals): inspect/find_paths/bundle_evidence/ref_size/blame now resolve edge-projected symbol vertices — ProviderContext carries an optional edge-index ref and the symbol/symbol_v2 providers fall back to edge-participation existence (source=edge_projection), keeping not_found for refs nothing points at. REMAINING: symbols still absent from hybrid_search (no entity docs in the search index) — exact-symbol eval queries cannot pass via the search-only strategy. Fix requires a corpus-design decision: emit ~110k symbol entity docs (index size + delete lifecycle) vs. a search-time symbol lane over the edge sidecar.
